Inclusion Criteria:
• Patients > 18 years old  [AND] with to ASA status I-III, undergoing VATS for lobectomy  [OR] or wedge

Non-inclusion Criteria:
  -  < 18 years old
  -  BMI > 35
  -  Chronic pain  [AND] history with regular opioid  [OR] and/or gabapentinoids use during the 2 weeks before surgery
  -  Regular marijuana use
  -  History of thoracic surgery on the operated side
  -  Epidural analgesia preferred due to an anticipated high risk of conversion to thoracotomy
  -  Unable to communicate with the investigators
  -  Receiving anticoagulation  [OR] or experiencing any bleeding disorder
  -  Surgery for empyema  [OR] and sympathectomy
  -  Known allergy to local anesthetics, [OR]  fentanyl  [OR] or hydromorphone
  -  Active infection at injection sites
  -  Preexisting neurological deficit  [OR] or psychiatric illness
  -  Severe cardiovascular disease
  -  Liver failure
  -  Renal failure (estimated glomerular filtration rate <15 mL/ min/1
